title: Formal smoothness transported to the double prime-power quotient
statement: Let $p,n,m$ be natural numbers with $n\leq m$, let $\Lambda$ be any commutative ring, put $R=\operatorname{ZMod}(p^m)$ and $S=\Lambda/(p^m)$, and fix an $R$-algebra structure on $S$. Suppose $\Lambda/(p^n)$ is formally smooth [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic] over $\operatorname{ZMod}(p^n)$ for every such algebra structure. Let $I=(p^n)\subset R$ and $J=IS$. The induced ring homomorphism $R/I\to S/J$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient] is formally smooth.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 0329 induction step; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0329

proof.text: Use q=ZMod.castHom from ZMod(p^m) to ZMod(p^n). It is surjective. Its kernel is I: write a class as an integer z and use ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd to express z as p^n times an integer; conversely q kills p^n. The first isomorphism theorem yields eR:R/I ≃ ZMod(p^n).

source.place: Algebra, Tag 0329 induction step; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0329

proof.text: Put K=(p^m) and L=(p^n) in Λ. The inequality n≤m gives K≤L. Since algebra maps preserve natural casts, J is the image of L in Λ/K. Apply DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLE to obtain eS:S/J ≃ Λ/L.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 0329 induction step; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0329

proof.text: Construct g:ZMod(p^n) → Λ/L as the quotient lift of Int.castRingHom, composed with the inverse of Int.quotientSpanNatEquivZMod. The lift is well-defined because p^n belongs to L. Give Λ/L the algebra structure g.toAlgebra; the hypothesis makes g formally smooth.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 0329 induction step; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0329

proof.text: RingHom.FormallySmooth.of_bijective and comp show that eS inverse composed with g composed with eR is formally smooth. After precomposition with the surjective map R→R/I it agrees with the induced quotient map by RingHom.ext_zmod. Surjectivity gives equality of the two maps, and hence the conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem modPow_formallySmooth_reduction
    (p : ℕ) (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ] (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n ≤ m)
    [Algebra (ZMod (p ^ m)) (Λ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : Λ) ^ m})]
    (ih : ∀ [Algebra (ZMod (p ^ n)) (Λ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : Λ) ^ n})],
      Algebra.FormallySmooth (ZMod (p ^ n)) (Λ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : Λ) ^ n})) :
    let I : Ideal (ZMod (p ^ m)) := Ideal.span {((p : ZMod (p ^ m)) ^ n)}
    let J := I.map (algebraMap (ZMod (p ^ m)) (Λ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : Λ) ^ m}))
    (Ideal.quotientMap J
      (algebraMap (ZMod (p ^ m)) (Λ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : Λ) ^ m}))
      Ideal.le_comap_map).FormallySmooth
